item.title: Ted Bundy's DNA linked to unsolved death of Utah teen in 1974, sheriff's office says
item.description: According to CBS News, new DNA testing has definitively linked the unsolved death of a Utah teenager in 1974 to the infamous serial killer Ted Bundy, the local sheriff's office said Wednesday.

item.title: Artemis II astronauts bound for moon after rocketing away on NASA’s first lunar voyage in decades
item.description: According to Associated Press, four astronauts embarked on a high-stakes flight around the moon Wednesday, humanity’s first lunar voyage in more than half a century and the thrilling leadoff in NASA’s push toward a landing in two years.

item.title: Americans say this is their savings "magic number" to retire comfortably
item.description: Sources from Associated Press say that Americans' "magic number" for the savings they need to retire with a measure of financial comfort is $1.46 million, according to new research from Northwestern Mutual.

item.title: CREATE Foundation provides valuable experience for local students
item.description: A partnership between The CREATE Foundation and local schools is pairing students with businesses and nonprofits. Allie Martin shows us how the Frank Spain Internship Program is helping a Tupelo non-profit and is also shaping the future goals of a high school senior.

item.title: Aberdeen family business celebrates 80 years
item.description: Decades ago, on April 1, the Comers started their family business. Jimmy Comer was only a year old when his father founded Comer Packing Company.
